einzeiler: Discussion on the Flock surveillance network and privacy in America.
kurzfassung: The hosts are joined by Dante and David Covucci to examine the Flock surveillance network. They break down the data it collects, who can access it, and its impact on American privacy. The conversation also touches on robots, nuclear weapons, and sports.
stichpunkte: Mechanics and data collection of the Flock surveillance network
Access rights and implications for privacy in America
